mapper.sql: empno, ename, job, mgr, hiredate, sal, comm, deptno, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM emp WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY empno
SELECT FROM emp WHERE empno = #{empno} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM emp WHERE deptno = #{deptno} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY empno

SELECT e.empno, e.ename, e.job, e.mgr, e.hiredate, e.sal, e.comm, e.deptno, e.deleted, d.deptno AS d_deptno, d.dname AS d_dname, d.loc AS d_loc, d.deleted AS d_deleted FROM emp e LEFT JOIN dept d ON d.deptno = e.deptno AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE e.empno = #{empno} AND e.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp (ename, job, mgr, hiredate, sal, comm, deptno, deleted) VALUES (#{ename}, #{job}, #{mgr}, #{hiredate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{sal}, #{comm}, #{deptno}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE emp SET ename = #{ename}, job = #{job}, mgr = #{mgr}, hiredate = #{hiredate,jdbcType=DATE}, sal = #{sal}, comm = #{comm}, deptno = #{deptno} WHERE empno = #{empno} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE emp SET deleted = 1 WHERE empno = #{empno} AND deleted = 0
